note: Small campground near Jameson (18515 MO-13): gravel back-in RV pads and one wide pad without hookups, plus tent sites and Amish-built bunkhouses. --Claude
summary: Confirmed private park: Campspot sells one night ($40 no-hookup, $46.20-49.50 hookup site, 8 of 8 hookup sites open on a November weeknight); own site $45/night; Google 4.8/60. Phone 480-201-9626 is the published number. Fees/hookups/sites/facilities/booking written manual; note trimmed of what fields hold.
flags: PRICE: cheapest one-night RV site $40 (no-hookup double-wide) and $46.20 weeknight / $49.50 Saturday for the 30/50 + water sites, site charge before Campspot checkout fees ($1 booking fee + ~2% card fee; totals $41.88 / $48.22 / $51.59). The hookup Saturday total crosses $50 only with the checkout fees, which are not counted. Under the $50 gate; no gateway within 40 km (nearest Kansas City 113 km), none needed.
PRESENCE: operator site honeygrovecampground.com with posted rates and its own phone, plus a live Campspot engine selling single nights. Google 'Honey Grove Campground' 4.8 over 60 reviews. Passes.

PHONE: stored 480-201-9626 is the park's published number (home page tel: link, 'Make Reservations by calling (480)201-9626', FAQ, and Google's place card +1 480-201-9626). One spot on the home page misprints it as 480-201-9262. Arizona area code but it is the number the park publishes; keep.

LONG-STAY TESTS (AWH 2026-10-14): (1) price under $50, pass; (2) nights sold on Campspot and by phone, no application/approval/rig photos, pass; (3) no minimum stay on Campspot, pass; (4) 8 of 8 Campspot hookup sites + the wide pad open for one night on Tuesday 2026-11-17, so nightly share is far over 1 in 10, pass; (5) not a home community, pass. The site does list long-term rates ($265/week, $629/month on the home page; FAQ 'RV weekly $200' and 'RV long term summer price (April-September) is only $550 a month'), dropped from the note as rates and kept here. Campspot lists 8 hookup sites against the 12 the operator describes; the other 4 may be held for long stays. Not mostly seasonal.
